d: Duckula goes to the Town Hall to get a grant for his crumbling castle.

t: Count Duckula: A Fright at the Opera
d: A homage to The Phantom of the Opera, as Nanny is kidnapped by The Phantom and Duckula must save her.

st: Close Encounters of the Absurd Kind
d: When Baron Greenback threatens to take down a tracking station, Danger Mouse and Penfold head to the Bermuda Triangle to stop him. But space aliens abduct them, hoping to probe them for further research.

st: The Good the Bad and the Motionless
d: Danger Mouse investigates strange goings-on at Stonehenge only to battle his devilish alter-ego.
Baron Greenback challenges Danger Mouse to a duel, where if Danger Mouse wins, Greenback will go straight and be good, but if Greenback wins, Danger Mouse has to quit his job.
Count Duckula is approached to perform as a prince in a Hollywood film.

Professor Squakencluck shows off his time machine. However, when Penfold gets too close to the machine's targeted area, he is sucked into the past, 150 million years ago, in exchange for a dinosaur egg. Danger Mouse heads back to look for him.

t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Butch Mario & The Luigi Kid
d: While trying to rescue the Princess from an abandoned mine, the Mario brothers find themselves running from Sheriff Mouser and his minions who are after the large reward Koopa has promised for their capture.
A ransom note is sent to Castle Duckula saying that Count Duckula has been kidnapped,.
Penfold and Danger Mouse journey to the center of the Earth to stop a loud noise that originates there.
Castle Duckula mistakedly lands in the middle of New York.

t: Count Duckula: Dr. Von Goosewing's Invisible Ray
d: Dr Von Goosewing, along with his new invisible ray, invades the castle in another attempt to kill Duckula
To prevent Missy from singing the Star-Spangled Banner in public, Bill and Ted travel back to the War of 1812 in order to convince Frances Scott Key to write a song that is easier to sing.

st: The Bad Luck Eye of the Little Yellow God
d: Baron Greenback has stolen a gem that is used to shoot a ray beam at people which results in them having extremely bad luck. Danger Mouse manages to get it and attempts to give it back to the original owners who do not really want it back.
Danger Mouse and Penfold find Baron Greenback's hideout, but the Baron has escaped, and Stiletto is left behind in disguise.
Duckula experiences some real bad luck on Friday the 13th
Duckula becomes a private detective in Chicago.
Duckula, Igor and Nanny take a rollercoaster ride through time...literally!
Duckula becomes a deputy in the Wild West.

st: A Safe Place / Peep-Peep-Peep / The Purple Paw Mystery / Bungo’s Birthday Party
d: Great Uncle Bulgaria needs somewhere to store an old history book.

Danger Mouse and Penfold go to the Amazon jungle where a tribe have been sacrificing people to The Great Ant God from Ataxia. Penfold is captured by the tribe and his "magic caterpillars" (eyebrows) are to be sacrificed.
Space alien J. J. Quark announces that he is going to claim the Earth as his.

t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Mario and the Beanstalk
d: Desperate for cash, the Marios trade the royal cow for bean seeds. Princess scolds them, and accidentally sneezes, blowing the beans into the yard.
Dr Quackbrain lures Duckula to his dream machine for his greatest experiment.

t: Count Duckula: The Rest is History
d: Duckula travels back in time to stop the first Count Duckula from becoming a vampire.
Greenback uses a spray on the world's leaders to cause them to laugh.
Bored with the look of the castle, Duckula hires a designer to redecorate the castle.

t: Count Duckula: Hunchbudgie of Notre Dame
d: Duckula, Igor and Nanny are involved in a series of art thefts in Paris.

While vacationing in the canals of Venice, Danger Mouse and Penfold bump into a highway undergoing construction, being built by Baron Greenback, who holds a document that allows him to construct whatever he wants.

st: I Spy with My Little Eye...
d: Danger Mouse and Penfold head to the North Pole on news that Baron Greenback and Stiletto have been selling over a thousand heat lamps to the Eskimos and causing the polar ice caps to melt.

st: Have You Fled from any Good Books Lately?
d: Penfold gets a pop-up book of monsters from a mysterious book sales club, but it turns out to be from J.J. Quark who turns the monsters in the book alive. Danger Mouse eventually turns the tide by drawing in a monster of his own.

Danger Mouse and Penfold head to the Tower of London to look for thieves that are after the crown jewels. They find a grandfather clock but when they enter it, they find they are actually in a time machine.

t: Count Duckula: The Lost City of Atlantis
d: Count Duckula and co. are stuck on a tiny island.

During an investigation where Danger Mouse and Penfold try to find out why elephants are being turned into sugar cubes, a fall causes Penfold to act weird and do a Tarzan yell that summons elephants to stampede the area.

t: Count Duckula: Venice a Duck Not a Duck
st: Venice a Duck Not a Duck
d: In Venice, the Egg plans to get his revenge on Duckula.
Duckula falls down a hole in the castle's cellar.
A salesman of gadgets for secret agents tries to sell Danger Mouse devices which will help him in reaching Greenback's hard to reach hideout.

t: Count Duckula: No Sax Please - We'r'e Egyptian
d: Count Duckula, Igor and Nanny travel to ancient Egypt in an attempt to recover an ancient artifact.

st: What a 3 Point Turn-up for the Book
d: Danger Mouse finds out he needs to hurry to attend an award ceremony, but the Mark III somehow cops an attitude and refuses to be controlled. Danger Mouse and Penfold spent most of the episode trying to chase the Mark III down.

Baron Greenback uses a shrink ray to enter Colonel K's body to learn all of the Colonel's secrets. Danger Mouse and Penfold follow, but they get diverted because Greenback changed some of the signs. They also have to deal with the body guarding cells.
Bill and Ted accidentally damage the Mona Lisa and go back in time to have it replaced.

t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Toad Warriors
d: In the badlands of Car Land, Mario, Luigi, Princess Toadstool and Toad are riding in a brown convertible car, planning on rendezvousing with several Mushroom rebels.
Danger Mouse and Penfold go after a mad composer who has destroyed all the world's music.

st: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure In Baby
d: When Ted's guitar is destroyed, the guys decide to replace it with a Fender Stratocaster that Mr. Preston had when Bill was a baby. Bill and Ted encounter themselves as toddlers and end up in a babysitting nightmare.
Duckula joins the French foreign legion in Leicester.
